The '''Mission to Imperial Prison ISO-L8''' took place several months after the creation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Assassin/Legends|Assassin]] [[Falco Sang]] infiltrated [[Imperial Prison ISO-L8]] in order to find [[Janks]] and informations about [[Dass Jennir]].
